method: Manual whole-file reading of three files; byte comparison against pinned Git objects. No upstream tests, builds or desktop actions executed.
findings: Wait-AppIdle requires enabled main window and title without scanning/percentage/suspended markers stable450ms. Wait-AppScanning requires title marker plus enabled suspend command. Neither reads worker state or joins; these are observable UI synchronization heuristics.

Get-StableFrame exposes/captures screen, compares successive frames via Desktop.Difference with default RGB tolerance8, and requires zero above-tolerance changed pixels across adjacent captures for300ms. This does not require exact bytes or comparison to a fixed first frame.

Assert-FrameEqual accepts changed-pixel fraction up to0.001 after color tolerance, saves expected/actual PNGs only above that fraction. Assert-GraphRendered requires more than24 distinct RGB colors; neither establishes semantic graph correctness independently.

Stop-TestApp requests WM_CLOSE and waits up to8seconds, verifies normal exit when observed, otherwise kills tracked process tree and fails unless explicitly forced. Unexpected process exits during general waits are checked in Core.ps1.

Find-AppRow uses case-insensitive exact-display-name or basename matching, demands exactly one match, and fails on ambiguity. The case-sensitive scenario obtains exact-name indices through Array.IndexOf for its metadata assertion instead. This limits generic row targeting in case-distinct populations.
Show-LargestFunctions builds a Release MAP or reuses existing artifacts and ranks approximate adjacent-RVA sizes. No timing measurement or build freshness validation is performed by SkipBuild.

Show-InlinedFunctions compares default Release with another build that changes inlining, whole-program optimization and link-time code generation together. Missing standalone MAP symbols are labeled fully inlined, but symbol absence alone cannot distinguish inlining from other elimination/folding/optimization effects, and binary-size differences cannot be attributed only to inlining.
limits: Windows UI and MSVC runtime behavior not executed. No current graph pass or upstream performance claim inferred.
